headline: VIPER PIT: the challenger's pick always wins
lede: A resumed session finished a dead lane's near-ship: the net-select gate now defers the host's FIGHT until the challenger's pick lands — and the live drive proved the wire had been eating every pick in secret.

notes.text: #2476 shipped (a9ee5cc): host FIGHT before the guest's pick DEFERS, the late pick launches both boxes on the challenger's REAL choice, and a leaving challenger un-hangs the gate. Two more bugs died with it: the relay silently dropped every `pick` packet in production, and a leaked StrictMode socket held the challenger's seat forever.

viperpitcheck 441/441 with mutants 290/290 (the named gateOn mutant bites), vipernet live two-Chrome relay drive 13/13 (race / pre-pick / ghost), and the gate marker verified in the live production chunk.

The warden's idle-kick and this session were twins — both resumed the same corpse. The twin merged first; the failed merge was diagnosed, not retried, and the duplicate QA filing folded into #2482. After any failed `gh pr merge`, check `gh pr view --json state` before touching anything.
